title_card.title: Cologne Cathedral took 632 years.
title_card.subtitle: A crane stood on its tower for centuries.

caption:
Cologne Cathedral took 632 years to finish, and a medieval crane stood on its unfinished tower for centuries.

Construction began in 1248 but halted in 1560, leaving a massive wooden crane perched on the incomplete south tower. For over three hundred years, the skyline remained unchanged until building resumed and finished in 1880.

Visuals created with AI.

Could you spend generations building something you would never see finished?
